The framework-agnostic cookie consent UI primitives, CSS, and theme tokens behind the c15t React, Vue, Svelte, and Astro components. Most apps get this package through a framework adapter and do not install it directly.

c15t is used by [2,100+ sites](https://www.wappalyzer.com/technologies/cookie-compliance/c15t/), including expo.dev, zed.dev, unkey.dev, mintlify.com, and sazabi.com.

## Key Features

- One theme system for every c15t framework: set `--c15t-*` tokens once and the banner, dialog, and preference center follow
- Stylesheets for plain CSS and Tailwind CSS, with a separate file for Tailwind CSS 3
- Framework-agnostic primitives for building a c15t adapter for another UI framework

## Installation

The framework packages (`c15t/react`, `c15t/vue`, `c15t/astro`, `@c15t/svelte`) depend on this package and re-export its stylesheets. Install it directly only to build your own adapter:

```bash
pnpm add @c15t/ui
```

## Security

Do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/c15t/c15t/security/advisories/new). We examine every valid report.

- Do not share the vulnerability in public forums, issues, or pull requests
- Give the steps to reproduce it and the versions it affects
- Give us time to release a fix before you disclose it
